dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Ten minutes. We check the break room, close two loose ends, and go back to work.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: You promised ten minutes last time. I brought an emergency biscuit.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: I'm behind the screen trying to get into the wall. Some of us have work scheduled after this.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: You have exactly the same ten minutes as everyone else.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: I started the clock when you said good morning.

dialogueInline.speaker: Brick Talos
dialogueInline.text: And so the countdown becomes the suspect.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Three items. Not a review of everything that's happened since soup was invented.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: For the record, I did come by Kreeb's quarters after the incident.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: At midnight. Without knocking.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: It's impressive how thoroughly you've not attended a party.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: Can I please show you something? The sample behaved differently when I warmed it.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: We'll get to the sample, Mira. Apparently that dinner was more popular than this meeting.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: I made you a smaller dashboard. The original one had forty-two counters.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Did I ask for a dashboard?

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: You said you wanted to know whether the meeting was efficient.

dialogueInline.speaker: Brick Talos
dialogueInline.text: The numbers are clean. The alibis, less so.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: You've counted zero people saying 'someone should.' It's still early.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: I'm counting speakers, too. The timer isn't the only thing rising.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: We only need someone who knows the access panel and can change the date.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: I'm happy to lend my expertise. I'm less enthusiastic about being officially responsible.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: You did Kreeb's dishes for two hours. You can manage a label.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: He fed me first. That's a crucial part of the arrangement.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: Well, here's the label. The rest of the wall is currently behind our meeting.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: Fine. Give me a pen before I change my mind.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: We shouldn't put a name in an owner box merely because someone didn't move quickly enough.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: This is the most I've agreed with you all week.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: You were arguing about a chair ten minutes ago.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: A chair I had no intention of owning.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: Nobody volunteered to be a chair, either.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Can the two of you please stop finding philosophical problems with stationery?

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: The cable's warm. That's where the new residue is, not on anybody's agenda.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: We're nearly twelve minutes into a ten-minute meeting.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: I can take the sample after you move that screen. I'd rather not swab around Zib's elbow.

dialogueInline.speaker: Noola Vaneel
dialogueInline.text: You can both talk. You've been politely waiting for each other for a full minute.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: We aren't measuring politeness, Noola. I don't even know if we're measuring anything useful yet.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: I can record 'unknown.' The system doesn't like it, but I do.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: This screw is loose. Unlike the rest of us, it can actually leave this meeting.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: We're getting to the access panel.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: The timer says sixteen minutes.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: Move the screen. I was meant to meet the incoming supplies at Dock Two.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: There. Is that enough room?

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: For one hand. Fortunately, I brought both.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Someone should take a look at the old printer trigger.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: Jax's already holding the label. There's your first volunteer.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: The system has opened an unassigned task.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: No. I said I knew where it was. It's not the same as offering to become its legal guardian.

dialogueInline.speaker: Brick Talos
dialogueInline.text: A statement has been made. A witness is in possession of the object.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: A witness with a marker, if he'd use it.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: The microwave works, and the vent is clear. Item one is done.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: The old printer still responds to the completion signal. Pixa can confirm it.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Does anyone actually want the printer to do that?

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: I kept one of the notices. It was the oldest working machine in that corner.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: He doesn't want it switched back on. He just doesn't want you to call it rubbish.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: I'll keep the old mapping in the archive. We can leave the counter quiet.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: There's more residue by the cable, but nothing here tells me what caused it.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: The graph rises with time in the room.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Don't tell central it rises with arguments. We'll have an argument budget.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: I wasn't planning to. I wanted another sample, not another explanation.

dialogueInline.speaker: Noola Vaneel
dialogueInline.text: I could've told you the meeting was getting longer without an instrument.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: That's the problem with a good instrument. I always want to ask it one more question.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: This chart is making the meeting feel longer.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: I can hide it.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Thank you.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Why does hiding it make me feel like I've lost the argument?

dialogueInline.speaker: Brick Talos
dialogueInline.text: The figures remain. Their disguise has changed.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Glorp is going to want a record of where you put the numbers.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: I can help the person who's assigned. I can tell them which access panel is lying about its date.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: I've recorded an offer of support. That wasn't an offer to own the task.

dialogueInline.speaker: Brick Talos
dialogueInline.text: A capable accomplice who won't accept the crime.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: You could do it, Brick. You'd love the evidence labels.

dialogueInline.speaker: Noola Vaneel
dialogueInline.text: He wants you to say his name so he can complain about being volunteered.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: A fair accusation. Still not signing the form.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: We've made four decisions, and I have one person willing to put a name on them.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: That is correct. The choices are clear. The owners are not.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Glorp, what actually happens if we leave a name blank?

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: Someone else discovers the work on Friday and wonders why it's now theirs.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: That happened to you, didn't it?

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: It's happened to everyone. Some of us just keep the receipts.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: All right. We can leave the line blank without pretending it's finished.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: Traceable responsibility. Otherwise people argue about what was promised.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: And nobody gets an assignment just because they were kind enough to sit through a meeting.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Can we write both sentences without making them an oath?

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: I'd feel more comfortable if someone could say no.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Then stop asking me to put names in the empty boxes.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: I can call them open tasks. We don't need to pretend they were accepted.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: I finally have enough space to work. Jax, where's the old label?

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: I was going to ask—

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: I'll change it. I know the panel, and I'd rather do it than keep talking about it.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: Did I just volunteer? I'm going to regret the historical record.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: You did. I will record it accurately.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: Then start with today's date. Try not to make the future someone else's problem.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Forty-six minutes. We've nearly used a lunch break discussing how to give people their lunch breaks back.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: If you're worried about the timer, I can turn it off.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Turn off the screen. Let Zib work.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: What about the outstanding records?

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: I'll take them. I can read them without a roomful of witnesses.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: These two names are still blank.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Then they're still open. It's not a crime.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: I know. I just dislike sending people home with promises that aren't really promises.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: Neither do I. They can decide tomorrow when the work is in front of them.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Good. Everybody who has something to do, go do it.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: I'll mark the meeting over, not the work.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: At last. I can see the entire wall.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: The access number was wrong. Whoever wrote this thought a four looked like a nine.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: I'm calling it 'unknown' until I can reproduce it. Don't let anybody call it a mood indicator.

dialogueInline.speaker: Noola Vaneel
dialogueInline.text: I wouldn't dream of it.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: This little card would fit beside the record rack.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: And wouldn't make anyone sit through a seminar about it.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: I'll put the screen away. Somebody has to.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: I can carry the cable. I'm good company while walking.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: Loose bracket. Not exactly the mystery of the century.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: The number is wrong here too. Who labeled this, somebody wearing oven gloves?

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: You did. Three months ago.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: Then I stand by the oven-gloves theory. New date, correct number.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: Eight minutes and forty-one seconds since the wall became accessible.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: Don't tell Astra that. She'll schedule another meeting to celebrate.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: I saw the new label. Thank you.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: Don't make a thing of it. Kreeb will think you've invited me to wash up again.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: I'm capable of saying thank you without opening an agenda.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: The residue sample is still too small to explain anything.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: I wish that bothered me more than it does. It's interesting.

dialogueInline.speaker: Noola Vaneel
dialogueInline.text: You sound exactly like you did before dinner last week.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: You can stop watching the number. The bracket is fixed.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: Two jobs finished, one accepted and still open. No new meetings.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: I'm quite pleased with that last figure.

dialogueInline.speaker: Brick Talos
dialogueInline.text: I suspect someone is concealing a meeting.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: The zero is the only number I'd like to keep.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: Then don't give it a title and invite everybody back.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: There are still open items. Would you like another ten-minute follow-up?

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: No.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Reason: People are working.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: The calendar has accepted that.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Then let it be surprised.
